items.toString:
h3. Environment

QA branch https://sv8785.qa.shopview.com/workorders 

h3. Steps to Reproduce

# Open Work Orders on desktop, All tab, with no filters and nothing typed in the page Search.
# Click the "Search" button in the page toolbar (to the left of the columns icon) and type: Lastone

Observe: 
The Page wont filter the results with Lastone.


h3. Expected Result

The page should show the data related to Lastone only.


h3. Current Result

Page search is not working.

h3. 

!image-20260805-024810.png|width=921,alt="image-20260805-024810.png"!

[^screen-capture - 2026-08-05T074453.985.webm]

 

Where this expected behaviour comes from: the Filters specification, version 18, requirement S13-R7, which says: "The query applies as the user types, debounced at 300ms. There is no apply or submit button and Enter is not required."

And requirement S13-R12, which says: "Results replace the table contents in place. There is no separate results view or results page." Together those two mean that typing into the page search must narrow the list on the page itself.

items.fromString:
h3. Environment

QA branch https://sv8785.qa.shopview.com/workorders — API host sv8785api.qa.shopview.com — build marker <meta name="app-version"> = v3.4.2-4f8211c (index.html last-modified Mon, 03 Aug 2026 20:09:32 GMT) — observed 2026-08-04, org d55bc308-e61a-438d-b5f1-c7a73c89d49f, location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919", signed in as an Administrator.

h3. Steps to Reproduce

# Open Work Orders on desktop, All tab, with no filters and nothing typed in the page Search.
# Click the "Search" button in the page toolbar (to the left of the columns icon) and type: Lastone
# Check that the list narrows to the two Lastone Construction work orders S2-9473 and S2-9120.
# Now type something that matches nothing, for example: ZZQQNOMATCHXX
# Close the browser completely (not just the tab) and open it again, sign in, and go to Work Orders.

h3. Expected Result

What you typed in the page search belongs to that browser tab only. When you come back later the search box is empty and you see the normal, unsearched list of work orders.

h3. Current Result

The text you typed is saved against your user account. When you come back later the page re-applies it by itself: the address bar becomes .../workorders?search=ZZQQNOMATCHXX and the list shows NO work orders at all. A user who does not notice the search box will believe their work orders have disappeared.

h3. How often

Every time.

h3. Technical detail

Typing in the page search fires PUT /api/users/me/preferences/work-orders-list with the query inside the saved value, e.g. {"value":{"tab":"estimate","filters":{},"collapsed":false,"columns":{...},"sortBy":"companyName","descending":true,"search":"Lastone"}} and the following GET returns it. Verified in a brand-new browser context with empty localStorage and sessionStorage, which restored search=ZZQQNOMATCHXX and rendered zero rows. The specification is explicit that the query must never be stored against the account: S10-R5, S13-R25 and S13-N4.
